THE SNITCH delivers a wealth of these classic tones via two distinct modes. ​ • OLD SCHOOL: Smooth distortion with a late 70’s hard rock feel. Dial back the GAIN knob for warmer overdriven sounds, or crank it to get into fuzz territory rich with overtones. ​ • TURBO: A barrage of extra output for a bombardment of edgier distortion that’s right at home in lo-fi/post-punk/indie/noise rock sounds.
